name: Dub garage sub
desc: Round triangle sub, shaped hot for harmonics, slow-breathing lowpass wobble and dubby delay tails. Sparse skanking rhythm over a G-Em-D walk with silent-cycle breathing in sparse, walking octave lines at peak.

wob.doc: wobble rate in cycles, bare JS arg

code.full: note("<g1 g1 <e1 e1 e1 [e1 g1]> <d1 f#1>>").struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ [~ x] ~ ~").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").lpf(sine.range(60, ${cut}).fast(${wob})).lpq(7).attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.55).release(.15).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).delay(.3).room(.1).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1 g1 a1 b1] [g1 g1 a1 b1] [e1 e1 g1 a1] [d1 d1 f#1 a1]>").struct("[x ~ x ~] [~ x ~ x] [x ~ ~ x] [~ x x ~]").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").lpf(sine.range(80, ${cut}*1.4).fast(${wob})).lpq(9).attack(.008).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.1).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).delay(.3).room(.12).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
